items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The man used to... Hire that professor that was Governor Warman. He was on Governor Warman plantation.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the band from down at the Magnolia plantation, where um... Chris Kelly came from up and down there. Jim Robinson was down there. Sonny Henry and...

They didn't have no bands come from down there. You didn't hear any musicians from down there. They didn't, the old man uh... See they were down there on the plantation. Deer Range. Deer Range. Yeah. And you take uh... You take old man... Uh... Ulfrey. Used to go down to teach him. Yeah, Jim Humphrey used to go down to teach him. Used to go down to teach him. Used to go down to teach him. Yeah. The man used to... Hire that professor that was Governor Warman. He was on Governor Warman plantation. Yeah.
For most of them they had a hall at Deer Range. Cause I played that one Sunday at Deer Range.
